$Comment: The World bars: the wide panel for values that move while a player is out in the world with
no ledger for them to sit beside. Which panel a row lands on is decided by the mod reporting
the movement, so a value only appears here if that mod put it here.
Placement names the spot the panel sits at, one of the files under
Server/ZiggfreedCommon/HudSpots/. Two are shipped for this panel: Top_Right, where it sits as
shipped, six columns wide above the quest tracker and growing leftward as columns open; and
Bottom_Left, three columns wide above the hotbar, growing upward as rows come up, leaving a
band clear for your own health and mana bars and stepping around the utility slot. The spot's
file carries the corner, the offsets, how the rows spread there, the band, the cut and the
least height. To nudge it without changing the spot, add a Position block here with only the
leaves you want different, or a Columns, RowsPerColumn, Gap, Cutout, MinHeight or Color leaf;
anything you leave out keeps the spot's own value. A player may pick either spot for
themselves in the HUD settings.
MaxVisible is unstated, so every slot the spot's columns can hold is available. RepaintMs is
how often the panel redraws at most: a movement redraws immediately when the last redraw is
already that old, and one arriving sooner is drawn at the window's end. LabelKey names the
panel in the HUD settings, and Order is where it is listed there: lower numbers first, so this
panel (Order 10) comes before the Activity ledger (Order 20), with room between them for a
panel of your own. Order is only the listing; it does not change which panel draws over the
other where two overlap on screen.
To change a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'World_Bars' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-panels.json with only the leaves you want different, or use the
Server tab of the HUD settings, which writes that file for you. Set Enabled to false there to
switch this whole panel off for everyone.
